race.comment: CAB FRANC (2) is coming along nicely, running on well in a handy maiden at Cranbourne to grab third when going 1100m-1400m. Now should be at peak fitness and will roll forward from the wide gate. Hard to beat. MAJESTIC FLYER (7) just found one better on debut at Bendigo at a big price. Can improve off that and looks a key chance again. JULIUS MAXIMUS (6) was good on debut at Cranbourne when boxing on well for a narrow third and is another that looks to push on from a wide gate. HURTLING (5) is a three-year-old colt out of the stakes performer Savanah Rush. Coming along well at the trials with a minor placing at his most recent at Flemington. Watch the betting.
